text:
nina: FYI — our eu-west firewall preflight landed in Terraform pipeline and tightened outbound CIDRs to the privatelink proxies. Im seeing walrus (gpu) nodes fail to finish bootstrap.
sam: saw that too. warmpool join hanging. nodes report: "dial tcp 10.2.5.4:443: i/o timeout" when talking to privatelink proxy.
tara: can someone paste the exact ip/sg diff from the TF change? thinking it might have replaced the /16 with a /24 by mistake.
nina: diff shows we replaced aws_security_group_rule.egress["keystore-proxy"] from cidr_blocks = ["10.2.0.0/16"] to ["10.2.5.0/24"] in module/edge/egress.tf. That excludes the proxy addresses used by some AZs.
ops-oncall: opening incident INC-5999. immediate mitigation: allow outbound 443 from gpu-subnets to 10.2.0.0/16, and trigger warmpool scale check. Approval?
sam: approve emergency SG exception. tagging for rollback after stabilization.
ops-oncall: executing quick fix (aws cli):
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-gpu-edge --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.0.0/16 --region eu-west-2
```
infra-ci-bot: terraform plan flagged drift after manual change; will block next pipeline until PR reconciles.
tara: after rule add, nodes started TLS handshakes again. sample error from earlier: "2026-03-23T11:12:08Z keystore-proxy: TLS handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate" — looks like proxy retries also dropped audit events.
audit-bot: detected missing keystore.decrypt events between 2026-03-23T11:05:00 and 2026-03-23T11:18:00 for eu-west-2. Filed SIEM ticket SIEM-1325 for re-ingest.
sam: impact note: autoscaler created 6 extra nodes in us-east as regional fallback when eu nodes failed. Cross-region pulls for model shards ~1.2TB egress, rough cost +$1.7k. add to RCA.
ops-oncall: mitigation status: temp egress rule in place, warmpool has +6 healthy nodes, provisioning backlog cleared. Keeping incident open for SIEM confirmation and TF roll-forward.
nina: opened PR https://git.internal/rw/firewall/pull/919 that reverts the accidental /24 and adds an explicit aws_security_group_rule for gpu-subnets -> privatelink proxies, plus a CI preflight test that curls the keystore health endpoint via the proxy from a canary GPU image.
tara: also suggesting a pre-apply validation in the Terraform pipeline that verifies CIDR superset for keystore-proxy rules (INFRA-480). filing the ticket now.
ops-oncall: logged INFRA-480 and assigned to infra-automation.
infra-ci-bot: blocked pipeline: manual confirm required before next apply.
audit-bot: SIEM-1325 updated: retention team accepting re-ingest request; ETA 24h.
ops-oncall: incident INC-5999 -> status: mitigated (temporary rule added). Will close after SIEM backfill and PR merge.
nina: follow-ups: PR review, add preflight check, cost estimate for retro, and update runbook to include CIDR superset check.
sam: one more ask — can we add an automated smoke from each AZ in rollout job? saves the manual rollback ping.
tara: yep adding to INFRA-480 scope.
ops-oncall: thanks all. will update INC-5999 and SIEM-1325 tickets with timelines. :thumbsup:
